name: Return & Withdrawal Manager Lite for WooCommerce
author: SDC PLugins

sections.description:
Return & Withdrawal Manager Lite for WooCommerce gives store owners a structured way to receive manual return and withdrawal requests from customers.

The plugin adds a public form where customers can enter their order number, contact details, the products they want to withdraw or return, and an optional message. The request is saved in WordPress, the store receives an email notification, and the customer receives a confirmation copy for their records.

It is built for WooCommerce stores that want a lightweight request intake flow without adding a full returns management system.

What the Lite version does

  • Adds a public withdrawal/return request form with a shortcode
  • Collects order number, name, email, products/items and optional message
  • Sends an email notification to the store
  • Sends a confirmation email to the customer
  • Saves requests in a basic WordPress admin overview
  • Lets store managers set request status: New, Processing, Completed or Rejected
  • Allows configuration of notification email, default withdrawal period and form intro text
  • Automatically creates a form page on activation
  • Includes English as the default language and Danish translation files

Pro version

The Pro version is designed for stores that want deeper WooCommerce automation.

Pro adds secure order links, prefilled order data, item-level selection, duplicate protection, WooCommerce order notes, B2B/VAT awareness, multilingual templates, license-based updates and more advanced store handling.

Learn more at:
https://sdcplugins.com/return-withdrawal-manager/

Shortcode

Use this shortcode on any page where customers should be able to submit a request:

[rwm_lite_withdrawal_form]
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/return-withdrawal-manager-lite-for-woocommerce/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. A page named “Return & Withdrawal” is created automatically with the shortcode [rwm_lite_withdrawal_form].
  4. Go to Return Requests > Settings to configure notification email, default withdrawal period and form intro text.
  5. Test the public form and confirm that your store receives the notification email.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace legal advice?

No. The plugin helps collect and document customer requests. Store owners remain responsible for their own terms, policies, legal compliance and customer handling.

Does the Lite version connect directly to WooCommerce orders?

No. The Lite version collects manual requests based on the order number entered by the customer. The Pro version adds secure WooCommerce order links and prefilled order data.

Can customers select specific products from their WooCommerce order?

Not in the Lite version. Customers manually describe the products and quantities they want to withdraw or return. Automated item-level selection is available in the Pro version.

Does the customer receive a confirmation email?

Yes. After submission, the customer receives a basic confirmation email containing a copy of the request details.

Can I change where store notifications are sent?

Yes. Go to Return Requests > Settings and update the notification email.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. The plugin uses English as the default language and includes Danish translation files.

What data is stored?

The plugin stores the submitted request details as private WordPress records so store managers can review and process them. It also stores plugin settings such as notification email and default withdrawal period.
